subject: Big number
author: Xandu
body:
I think that would be pronunced:

Eighteen quintillion
four hundred and fourty six quadrillion
seven hundred and fourty four trillion
seventy two billion
eight hundred and nighty five million
two hundred and fourthy eight thousand
three hundred and eighty four

(split on multiple lines for readability)

Seems like there must have been some kind of overflow when it shows the number in your stats. The obvious answer would be that they are trying to format a unsigned 32 bit integer as a signed 32 bit integer but I have trouble to see how that could make the big number you get. 🤓

-- The Creator --

subject: Because you did it with a
author: Glesga Maestro
body: Because you did it with a speed car with a burnout chain. It has problems registering it that way.
